santiago.title: RED Movilidad (Santiago)
santiago.description: How do you want to identify the bus stop?

codigo.title: Bus stop code
codigo.description: Enter the code as shown on the stop sign or in the Red app (for example PA433 or PI369).

buscar_linea.title: Search by route
buscar_linea.description: Enter the route number (for example 506, J10 or 210), then pick a stop along it.

elegir_paradero.title: Choose a stop
elegir_paradero.description: Stops along the route, both directions.

regional_paradero.title: Bus stop in {ciudad}
regional_paradero.description: Enter the stop code as shown in the Red Regional app, or part of its name to search for it (for example a street). Accents and capital letters do not matter.

regional_resultados.title: Choose a stop
regional_resultados.description: Stops matching your search. Some of their routes are shown next to each one, to tell apart stops with the same name.

linea.title: Filter by route (optional)
linea.description:
Stop {paradero} - {nombre}.

Leave the route blank to choose between two sensors with the nearest arrivals of any route, or one pair of sensors per route at the stop.

error.codigo_invalido: The code does not look valid (letters + number, e.g. PA433).
error.api_no_disponible: Could not reach the server. It fails often: try again in a few seconds.
error.linea_desconocida: That route is not in Red's service list.
error.sin_resultados: No stops found for that route.
error.paradero_no_encontrado: There is no stop with that code or name in this city.
error.demasiados_resultados: Too many stops match. Enter a more specific name, for example the corner of two streets.
error.gtfs_no_disponible: Could not download the list of stops for this city. Try again in a few seconds.

abort.already_configured: That stop is already configured with that route or mode.

init.title: Change route or mode
init.description:
Stop {paradero} - {nombre}.

Leave the route blank to choose the sensor mode.
